chosen_archive: context_archive: flat entries with exactly context, keys, candidates, completion
capture_boundary: Before retained candidate occupancy refresh in _install; confirm capture before context replacement in next_alternative.
repeat_without_replay: Reuse the existing literal old context/prefix/completion archive; never label refreshed packets as emitted by the old context.
after_replay: The next retention archives the newly genuine current context, ordered prefix and completion separately.
bounds: At most maximum_events active archive entries across retained cursor slots; tick-charged deep copies and comparisons; exhaustion raises Unresolved/UNKNOWN, never pruning. Original native memory/time gates remain mandatory.
nonrecursive: Entries contain no slots, archives, transfer chains or other entries.
rollback: Archive is inside the existing copy-on-write slot checkpoint/snapshot payload.
